channel.title: Project Planar Player's Guide
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Project Planar Player's Guide

item.title: 462 Eurus
item.description: 462 · Eurus Eurus is the east wind, warm and bright, and the only one of the four who keeps a form that is pleasant to be near. He likes mortals.

item.title: 463 Notus
item.description: 463 · Notus Notus is the south wind.

item.title: 464 Zephyros
item.description: 464 · Zephyros Zephyros is the west wind. Very few people have described him and their descriptions do not agree.

item.title: 461 Boreas
item.description: 461 · Boreas Boreas is the north wind.

item.title: 244 Tied On in Ventis
item.description: 244 · Tied On in Ventis Reachable only from a patron page. If you got here another way, tell me. Ventis is mostly open sky.

item.title: 242 Standing in the Heavens
item.description: 242 · Standing in the Heavens Reachable only from a patron page. If you got here from somewhere else, tell me.

item.title: 243 Passing Through Tarkis
item.description: 243 · Passing Through Tarkis Reachable only from a patron page. If you got here another way, tell me.

item.title: 430 The Archangels
item.description: 430 · The Archangels Six of them, each the other half of an archdevil.

item.title: 431 Blythe
item.description: 431 · Blythe Blythe is the Archangel of Temperance.

item.title: 432 Neema
item.description: 432 · Neema Neema is the Archangel of Kindness, and the other half of Abaddon, the Archdevil of Cruelty.
